title: The Lore pane's full mode follows the engine's sizing per DEC-154: rows - 11 inline, a dock ask from the drawn frame, the kept-width message, and tool answers that report the drawn size
description:
Source: DEC-154, ruled by opum-doc under Article 5 delegation (seq 227 and seq 230, recorded on opum-agent OPAG-1075 at origin/dev `ce2b3d2d`, read by ref 2026-10-03). Restated in opum-agent's fix instruction of 2026-10-03T15:13:10Z. It rests on LCLI-674's measurements of Claude Code 2.1.288 in real ptys and on cc-patch's decompiled engine arithmetic. quest-cli applies the same rules to the Quest board in its #486.

WHAT IS WRONG (LCLI-674 findings): the inline ask `rows - 6` exceeds the engine ceiling max(rows/3, rows - 11) by ~5, so full can never be granted as asked and the pane always showed the shortfall hint; the dock ask is computed from the conversation column (viewport.columns) -- a shrink request -- and a kept pluginPanes.dockColumns (80 on this machine) beats every request; the dashboard tool answers the asked size, photographed saying "the full size" while drawn=36 and ask=43 with the hint showing.

THE RULES TO IMPLEMENT (DEC-154; rule 2 as amended by seq 230):
1. Inline/main screen: full asks `rows - 11` (PROMPT_FLOOR_ROWS 8 + TRANSCRIPT_PEEK_ROWS 3), replacing `rows - 6`. Inline grants landing below the cap are accepted: the frame and controls take the difference.
2. Dock: terminal width = viewport.columns (the transcript column) + the pane's current drawn width + 1 (the divider), from the same render; clamp the ask to terminal width - 24. Ask ONCE per toggle (a person's z, or a tool call with full), using the latest render, never on a resize or a redraw. A stored full mode restored at session start asks once, on its first render.
3. A kept width is the person's choice. Never edit ~/.claude.json and never try to defeat it. While one holds, full says so plainly in the pane, e.g. "Width kept at 80 (you set it): drag the pane edge to change". Show no generic held hint, and never label it "Full screen".
4. Tool answers report the DRAWN size, never the asked one. Say "full size" only when drawn >= asked - 4. Otherwise give the drawn size and why, e.g. "Opened at 36 rows; the screen keeps room for the prompt". If the drawn size is unknown when the tool returns, say "full requested" and nothing more.
5. No cc-patch change.

CONSTRAINTS: stays within the 0.13.0 hold -- LCLI-665 is untouched and no version site changes. If a measurement contradicts a rule, report it to opum-agent with the evidence rather than diverging. Report the PR and its head SHA to opum-agent when ready for a by-ref spot-check. The landing must reach dev before LCLI-665's bump so the release carries the DEC-154 behaviour.

SURFACE: hooks/register.tsx (the full-screen toggle section: `wantedSize`, `DOCK_MARGIN_COLUMNS` / `PROMPT_AREA_ROWS`, `FULL_HINT`, the dashboard tool's `full` arm, the ui.render size block and the once-only `lastRequest` guard), tests/pane.test.tsx (the toggle-args, viewport-change and drag-hint tests assert the OLD constants and must move to the new ones -- note the existing "asks again when the viewport changed" test contradicts amended rule 2), docs/reference/lore-pane-mod.md (its Full screen section documents the 20-column margin, PROMPT_AREA_ROWS and the re-request on viewport change). Design of record: opum-doc docs/reference/pane-full-screen-and-quest-migration-skill-design.md section 1 as amended for DEC-154; NOTE its "Sizing details" bullet still says "again whenever the viewport size changes" where the ruling says never on a resize -- follow the ruling (both restatements agree), and the discrepancy is reported to opum-agent for opum-doc.

PRECEDENT: LCLI-666 (the toggle and layout this refines), LCLI-674 (the measurements), LCLI-668 (the dashboard tool), LCLI-664 (the mod and its harness).

acceptanceCriteria.text: Inline full mode asks rows - 11 (PROMPT_FLOOR_ROWS 8 plus TRANSCRIPT_PEEK_ROWS 3) on every path that raises it -- the person's z, the dashboard tool's full argument, and a stored full mode's first render -- asserted by the mod harness against the open args of a named inline render, with no path still asking rows - 6.

Dock full mode computes its ask from the same render: viewport.columns plus the pane's current drawn width (the drawn body, plus 1 for the frame column) clamped to terminal width - 24, and no ask is computed from the conversation width alone; the mod harness asserts the open args of a named dock render.

The ask is made once per toggle using the latest render: a later render of an already-full pane at a changed viewport issues no new open, and a stored full mode makes exactly one ask on its first render, both asserted in the mod harness; an unsized open raises one restoration ask and never lowers an ask already standing.

While a kept or chosen width holds -- read from the ask's outcome rather than the shortfall alone: a spent ask whose grant has not arrived -- the pane shows the kept-width line naming the drawn width, e.g. Width kept at 80 (you set it): drag the pane edge to change; the generic held hint is gone, a resize with nothing held stays quiet, and no pane surface labels the state Full screen while it is kept; an inline pane short of its ask shows no hint. Asserted in the mod harness.

The dashboard tool's answer reports the drawn size and never the asked one: full size only when drawn >= asked - 4 from the latest render (the boundary pinned at 4 by two renders one column apart); otherwise the drawn size and the reason, e.g. Opened at 36 rows; the screen keeps room for the prompt -- in the dock the width the person set only while a width reads as held, and the pane kept its width when none does; when no completed draw fixes the drawn size at answer time, full requested and nothing more. Driven in the mod harness against recorded draw states.

No cc-patch change and no write or workaround touching ~/.claude.json; the diff leaves every LCLI-665 version site untouched (no change to package.json, the npm manifests, .claude-plugin/plugin.json, any CHANGELOG version heading, or the lockfile), as the 0.13.0 hold requires.

On the head: bun run test:mod passes with the new tests, bun test passes, and bun run lore check exits 0 with the pane doc updated; any workstation-only failure is named with its reachability from this diff stated, and the mod typecheck state (clean, or NOT TYPECHECKED with the declaration named) is recorded.
The PR and its head SHA are reported to opum-agent for a by-ref spot-check, naming which DEC-154 rule each new test pins.

plan: Re-read the toggle, size and hint code in hooks/register.tsx and the existing expectations in tests/pane.test.tsx; enumerate every constant and test that moves.

Rewrite the sizing in hooks/register.tsx per DEC-154: inline rows - 11; dock ask from viewport.columns + drawn width + 1 clamped to terminal width - 24; ask once per toggle with a stored full mode asking once on its first render; kept-width line in place of the generic hint; tool answers from the latest recorded draw (drawn, never asked).

Move tests/pane.test.tsx to the new expectations: open args at named inline and dock renders, no re-ask on a changed viewport, exactly one ask for a restored full mode, the kept-width line, and the drawn-size tool answers; keep the split-layout and store tests green.
Update docs/reference/lore-pane-mod.md Full screen section through the lore workflow, then bun run lore check.
Run the gates on the head: bun run test:mod, bun test, bun run lore check; record the typecheck state and any workstation-only failure with its reachability.

Dispatch a reviewer pass over the diff before landing; then PR into dev, required checks green on the head, squash merge, close LCLI-675 in the delivering PR, and report the PR and head SHA to opum-agent.
implementationNotes:
IMPLEMENTATION + PR, 2026-10-03. Branch fix/LCLI-675-pane-full-sizing, PR opum-ai/lore-cli#486, head 8a782cfb (base dev 7dcbee81). The five rules are implemented in hooks/register.tsx: inline asks rows - 11 (PROMPT_FLOOR_ROWS 8 + TRANSCRIPT_PEEK_ROWS 3); the dock ask recovers the terminal per render (viewport.columns + the drawn body + 1 for the divider, less DOCK_FLOOR_COLUMNS 24, replacing DOCK_MARGIN_COLUMNS 20); pendingAsk replaces lastRequest/personRequest and asks once per toggle or per open that cleared the size, with a resize/redraw asking nothing; the kept-width line replaces FULL_HINT (dock-only; an inline shortfall is content-sized and silent); lastDraw feeds fullSizeAnswer (drawn vs ask within SIZE_SLACK, else the drawn size and why, else "full requested"). Tests moved to the measured shapes (80-column transcript + 79-cell drawn body = 160-column terminal, ask 136; 40 rows, ask 29) and gained: the one ask per session with a wider viewport asking nothing; the kept line present on the kept shape and absent on a granted one and at normal size; "full requested" before any full draw and "the full size" from a drawn record; the restoration ask after a tool call's unsized open, with a redraw control. Docs: docs/reference/lore-pane-mod.md Full screen + test summary rewritten through the lore workflow; CHANGELOG Unreleased-Fixed entry added.

GATES, pinned bun /opt/homebrew/bin/bun 1.4.2 (bare `bun` here is 1.3.14): node scripts/mod-test.mjs = 57/57 pass, claude plugin validate --strict passed, typecheck CLEAN against the engine-laid declaration for the 2.1.288 running the tests. bun run lore check (from source) exit 0, 0 errors 0 warnings. bun test = 4921 pass / 1 skip / 1 fail; the fail is test/link-quest-race.test.ts "an unrelated write to ANOTHER task ... (SF1: revision is workspace-wide)" -- PRE-EXISTING and unreachable from this diff, proven by a base-tree control (fails identically with this change stashed) and already recorded on LCLI-645, whose note also explains why CI is green on it vacuously: the file self-skips in the lint/typecheck/test job, which installs no quest. Nothing to file; LCLI-645 owns it.

Reviewer pass dispatched over 8a782cfb before landing. NOT yet landed; the criteria stay unchecked pending the reviewer and the required checks on the head.

REVIEW ROUND + FIXES, 2026-10-03. A reviewer pass over head 8a782cfb (opum-workflow reviewer, dispatched before landing) found two High defects and several test/copy gaps; all are addressed in the follow-up commit on the same branch.

- F1 (High, measured by the reviewer 3/3): a tool call or band press racing a person's z could destroy the standing ask -- openPane read the mode from before the toggle's write and assigned pendingAsk unconditionally, leaving the pane full-mode and unsized. Fixed: openPane now RAISES a restoration ask only when none stands and never lowers one; the mode-guarded spend plus assign-at-every-mode-change keep a surviving ask from misfiring. New test "an open never lowers the ask a person's toggle left standing"; against a reverted openPane (mutant 1) it is the only test that goes red.
- F2 (High, measured): the pane line and the tool's dock phrase asserted "(you set it)" wherever drawn < asked - 4, a state a resize reaches after a granted ask with nothing held (the reviewer's widened-render probe). Fixed: "a width holds" is read from the ask's OUTCOME -- only a spent ask sets awaitingGrant, a full-mode draw within SIZE_SLACK clears it, and the spend render is suppressed -- so the kept line and the tool's "the width you set is kept" fire only while an ask has gone ungranted; a shortfall with nothing holding draws nothing (pane) and says "the pane kept its width" (tool). Mutants: line ungated reddens only the kept-width test; tool phrase ungated reddens only the tool-answer test.
- F3 (Medium): the rule-4 middle arm -- the LCLI-674 photographed defect this task exists for -- had no test. New test drives all three arms in both placements ("opened at 12 rows; the screen keeps room for the prompt"; "opened at 80 columns; ...").
- F4 (Medium): once-per-toggle tests asserted last-open args, not counts. They now assert exact open LISTS, and a redraw with nothing raised adds nothing.
- F5 (Medium): SIZE_SLACK's value was unpinned and the granted control matched one exact string. The granted arm now matches /Width kept at/ (a line with another number cannot pass as absence), and the tool test pins the slack at 4 with two renders one column apart (transcripts 27 and 28; wanted - drawn = transcript - 23).
- F6 (Low): the dock formula's prose called the +1 a divider; the operand is the drawn body and the +1 is the pane's frame column at the transcript's edge. Comment, docs and test comments now say so.
- F7 (Low): AC5's text said "CHANGELOG ... change" while the branch adds an Unreleased bullet; amended to "any CHANGELOG version heading".
- F8 (Low, reasoned): lastDraw and awaitingGrant are now cleared at session.start, so a previous session's drawings cannot answer for this one. The compose-before-open ordering stays: the answer reports the latest completed render, which is what rule 4 asks for.

GATES on the reworked tree: node scripts/mod-test.mjs 60/60 pass, typecheck clean against the engine-laid 2.1.288 declaration; bun run lore check exit 0; bun test (pinned /opt/homebrew/bin/bun 1.4.2) 4921 pass / 1 skip / 1 fail -- the same pre-existing LCLI-645 SF1 red, unchanged. CI note on the first head 8a782cfb: the ubuntu leg went red on 10s/30s subprocess timeouts across unrelated files (windows green on the same commit; none reachable from this diff; nothing similar on the last five dev PR heads); gh run rerun --failed came back success, so that red was a runner stall, not the diff.

NOT yet landed: the reworked head goes to the PR now; criteria stay unchecked until the required checks on the final head are green.
finalSummary: All eight criteria verified at head 14a5e181 (opum-ai/lore-cli#486), green in CI run 37135923324: the inline ask rows - 11 on the z, stored and tool paths; the dock ask recovered per render as transcript + drawn + 1, less the 24-column floor (ask 136 at the measured 160-column shape); one ask per toggle or per open that cleared the size, never on a resize, and an unsized open never lowers a standing ask (the reviewer's F1 race, mutation-pinned); the kept-width line fires only while an ask has gone ungranted (the F2 fix), with the granted and resize-after-grant controls; the dashboard tool reports the drawn size across all three arms in both placements, with SIZE_SLACK pinned at 4 by the 27/28 boundary; no version site, no ~/.claude.json write, no cc-patch change. Gates: mod gate 60/60 with typecheck clean against the engine-laid 2.1.288 declaration; bun test 4921 pass / 1 skip / 1 fail (the pre-existing LCLI-645 SF1 red, control-verified against the base tree); bun run lore check exit 0.
